motivation: Historical action-semantic evidence for lifecycle/PRIMARY_ZONE/decision cannot be created post hoc (see ROUND1_ACTION_SEMANTIC_EVIDENCE_GAP). The only admissible new evidence is generated on genuinely future as-of-T days with inputs frozen at decision time.

non_evidence_rule.detail: Every day run under SHADOW_QUALIFICATION is permanently excluded from the H5/H20/H60 prospective research cohort, even if its audit passes. No selective retroactive inclusion.
non_evidence_rule.drill_days: Historical dates used only to validate machinery are marked DRILL_ONLY and can never count toward qualification coverage.

flow: frozen producer materializes day-T authority with deterministic traces
immutable qualification snapshot written under data/cd/shadow_qualification/YYYY-MM-DD/
independent bounded audit re-derives expected anchors from the same frozen inputs and written contracts
G-SHADOW-ACTION-QUALIFICATION accumulates coverage across real qualification days
independence_boundary: The audit must not import cd_shadow_runtime, cd_shadow_real_adapters, cd_shadow_materialize_*, or CD-7 production engines. Explicit re-written frozen rules are preferred over shared helpers.

activation_rule.precondition: G-SHADOW-ACTION-QUALIFICATION PASS (all production-critical categories covered with exact match on real qualification days)
activation_rule.effect: prospective evidence eligibility begins the NEXT trading day after activation; qualification days remain permanently non-evidence

readiness_composition.historical: authority/provenance/artifact-read/P0/L1-L3 anchors PASS; historical action parity stays EVIDENCE_UNAVAILABLE
readiness_composition.note: This substitutes new admissible evidence for unobtainable historical evidence; it does not rewrite history.

rules: No manufactured coverage: if real days only produce HOLD / PRIMARY_ZONE=false / no terminal transition, the gate stays PENDING. That is events-not-yet-occurred, not a stuck system. REDUCE/EXIT must arise from a state chain opened by a real prior ENTER day; historical replay or synthetic positions are forbidden.

Audit mismatch classification on real days: implementation mismatch -> qualification day INVALID/unresolved -> fix implementation fidelity or clarify the frozen contract -> policy semantics unchanged. Policy question -> not resolved during qualification -> fail-closed.
Qualification can fix implementation faithfulness; it can never tune policy performance.

Daily loop is exactly: freeze as-of-T inputs -> frozen runtime -> immutable qualification snapshot -> independent audit -> accounting -> update coverage. The gate accumulates only coverage-achieved and exact-semantic-match; it never inspects future returns.
Historical evidence reconstruction is CLOSED; no further design rulings are anticipated.
